name: R
source:
[spoiler]Like L, she is a designer human created for scientific research and was raised by a terrorist organization. Due to her natural weakness, R's heart broke and accepted brainwashing, transforming her into a ruthless killer. For that reason, she hates and envies L for remaining a good girl no matter how much time has passed.[/spoiler]

Her charm points are her single ponytail and her breasts, which are more like her mother's than L's.

"Fufu, make me feel so good A-G-L♪" 

[From [url=https://onlinegame-pla.net/grisaia-chronos-rebellion/]Online Game Planet[/url].]
